The only new information which has reached me about the LOEVENHEIMS is that they are again very active in political matters using for these activities the name of SERING.

E.7.(S) E.5.S.L.
10.4.42.

Spoke E5.(L) (Mr. Robert Scott)
No action should be taken on this report as the statement that LOEVENHEIM uses the alias, SERING, is inaccurate. This alias is used by Richard LOWENTHAL (Ref. 61620)
Feb. 17.11.42
